TimeWave Nano: Capsule Style Clock with Bluetooth Speaker

TimeWave Nano table clock redefines your space with its modern capsule design and multifunctional features. This Bluetooth speaker combines aesthetics with smart technology — perfect for home, office, or bedside use.

Product Highlights

  • Mirror Finish Display: Sleek and reflective LED mirror clock display that doubles as a decorative piece.
  • Bluetooth Speaker: High-fidelity sound quality for wireless music streaming via Bluetooth.
  • FM Radio & TF Card Reader: Tune into your favorite FM stations or play music directly from a TF card.
  • Compact & Portable: Lightweight capsule body ideal for travel or bedside setup.

Why Choose TimeWave Nano?

The TimeWave Nano Bluetooth speaker clock blends style and function effortlessly. Its mirror finish display enhances your décor, while the FM radio and TF card reader ensure versatile music options. With a powerful 1200 mAh battery, you enjoy uninterrupted entertainment on the go.

Perfect for Gifting & Corporate Use

Looking for a premium yet practical gift? The TimeWave Nano makes an ideal corporate gift, festive present, or addition to your home electronics. Its multifunctional design and elegant finish appeal to both tech enthusiasts and design lovers.
